title: ResponseConfigurationUpdateItemParam
description:
An update to the conversation's response configuration. Supply reasoning,
text, or both. Each setting stays in effect until a later update replaces it.

anyOf.description: The unique ID of the configuration update item.

reasoning.description: Updates to reasoning configuration. Only effort is supported.

effort.description:
The reasoning effort to use for subsequent responses until another
configuration update replaces it.

text.description: The text output configuration for subsequent responses.

format.description: Use a JSON schema for structured output or text to return to plain text.
